offers_products.reason: Sells SBCs, IP routers, optical networking systems, and software platforms like Acumen and Muse to carriers and enterprises.

offers_services.reason: Global services team handles design, deployment, maintenance and support of networks; secondary to product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are service providers, enterprises, defense and critical infrastructure; no household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to Verizon, Deutsche Telekom, BT, Liberty Mutual, American Electric Power and the US Department of Defense.

recurring_revenue.reason: Mostly telecom equipment and software sales and project deployments, with some support contracts; lumpy carrier capital spending.

cyclical_demand.reason: Carriers can defer network equipment and upgrade spending; revenue depends on telecom capex cycles.

big_ticket.reason: Optical and IP network systems and carrier voice platforms are large, infrequent purchases for telecom operators.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes mainly from networking hardware and software products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large carriers like Verizon, BT and Deutsche Telekom, plus defense and large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Designs networking and software products, with likely outsourced manufacturing; growth depends on R&D, not plants or fleets.
